title: BPW-2026-0599
text:
[JOINT REPORT(S)]
BPW-2026-0599
BSL + BCA
CD 9, 15
CONTRACT AWARD – MAIN STREET LIGHTING IMPROVEMENT UNIT 2 CIP
Recommending the Board:
DECLARE International Line Builders, Inc. dba ILB Electric, the first low bidder, to be the lowest responsive, responsible bidder, and award them a contract for this project for $3,108,681;
FORWARD a copy of this report to the affected Council District Office; and
AUTHORIZE the President or two Board of Public Works members to execute the contract for this project upon approval of all required documents by the City Attorney.
(W.O.: L1250076)
